name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据撑不起的词，一个都不写进结论
tagline_zh: 分析跑完最怕写结论时嘴瓢：把相关说成因果、把方向性说成定论。它给你一架「观察→方向→决策」的梯子，超一格就拦下。
tagline_en: Stops you from overclaiming in analysis write-ups—turns 'significant' into real effect sizes, blocks causal talk.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是改语气的润色器，是卡在结论和证据之间的安检门：先认你手里是观察、方向还是决策级证据。
why_en: Not a tone polisher—a gate between your data and your claims. It classifies evidence tier first, then decides which words are.
limit_zh: 只认文字输入，不读数据文件本身；不帮你算统计量，只约束你写出来的话。若原始分析本身有偏，它拦不住结论的错误。
limit_en: Text-only; won't read your data files or recompute stats. It polices wording, not study design—biased inputs still yield biased conclusions.
title_en: Writes only what the evidence can carry
